title: Propose from-scratch K1 K2 and K4 scaling arms
doing: Make K1/K2/K4 from-scratch arms an explicit S4 matrix alongside S3 warm starts. Use matched initialization within each replica, independent training replicas, fresh allowed seed streams, game-time-matched discounts and qualified long rollouts. Budget equal-frame and conditional extended stages separately; no launch or cohort opening is authorized.
expected: If inherited K4 behavior or optimizer state limits K1 adaptation, a from-scratch K1/K2 arm could outperform its warm start at sufficient exposure. If sample efficiency or planning limits dominate, K4 may remain preferable despite finer-control inference gains. No direction is assumed before measurement.
next_step: Keep all K1/K2/K4 scratch arms explicit; choose measured budgets and training replicas after S3 evidence and separate user approval.
